digest.component_or_area: advisory lock and ref lock modules (_advisory_lock.py, _ref_lock.py)
propositions: Unconditional top-level `from rebar_reconciler import git_adapter` imports at _advisory_lock.py:83 and _ref_lock.py:194 break standalone by-path module loading because the rebar_reconciler package is intentionally unavailable outside package context.
The held-out bridge preview contention test cannot acquire locks because _lock_remote fails at the first git_adapter import with ModuleNotFoundError when the module is loaded by file path.

Both _advisory_lock and _ref_lock must use `lazy_load("rebar_reconciler.git_adapter", "git_adapter.py")` to maintain compatibility with the standalone-safe loading contract and converge on a single sys.modules object shared with package-context importers.

The repair must preserve adapter API identity, lock semantics, intentional wheel packaging constraints, and module-qualified patch visibility across both standalone and package-context execution paths.
